name: Oncoinvent ASA
summary: Oncoinvent ASA is a biopharmaceutical firm dedicated to creating novel therapies for cancer. The company concentrates its efforts on building a diverse range of AXL kinase inhibitors. Its flagship product, bemcentinib, stands out as a highly selective, orally administered small molecule designed to inhibit AXL. James Bradley Lorens and David R. Micklem established the company on December 21, 2007, and it is based in Bergen, Norway.
